text: You know how the mechanism works. Now help someone else see it. Imagine Science helps you build scientific animations from your references with your coding agent. Start by building the scene, then show how the sequence unfolds. Slow the critical step so the audience can follow it, and match the narration to the action. As your explanation develops, adjust the timing, refine the labels, and keep shaping the same editable project. Explore Imagine Science on GitHub.

beats.title: From references to an editable scene
